records.source_context_population_selection: Bao scenario is conditional on the reported exclusions and retains a latent screen-detected high-glycemia class. Age is continuous uniform (20.01,80.01), a source support assumption avoiding the unresolved age-20 boundary. Sex probability is the reported count fraction; BMI/glucose/HbA1c baselines use reported medians as chosen location anchors, not asserted distribution medians. Other marginals and joint law, including a 4% excess class, mean excess 3 and log SD 0.5, are assumed. Shared baseline response slopes are a cross-source mechanism assumption; the Pearson comparison is a check, not calibration.
